name: Criticism of Marxism
notAnIdeology: Criticism of Marxism is a body of critiques, not a coherent set of political beliefs: its critics (Austrian economists, liberals, conservatives, anarchists, social democrats, and Marxists themselves) hold mutually opposed positions on most questions, so no single adherent profile exists; the related positive stances are covered under their own names such as anti-communism, liberalism and anarchism.
